card.name: Hyphens inside all-caps compound words
card.fires_on: The hyphen (or similar joining mark) inside an all-caps compound or name, such as LIFE-THREATENING or DRUG-INDUCED. It is strongest in capitalized warning headings and capitalized names.

modes.label: Hyphen in caps warning terms
modes.description: The hyphen joining two parts of an all-caps compound in boxed-warning headings.
modes.example: WARNING: ADDICTION, ABUSE, AND MISUSE; LIFE<<->>THREATENING RESPIRATORY

modes.label: Hyphen in capitalized names
modes.description: A hyphen or apostrophe-like mark inside a capitalized proper or scientific name.

card.plain: It lights up on the hyphen in capitalized compounds like LIFE-THREATENING in warning headings.
